Security remained the dominant concern after the $320 million Liquid Network exploit. 🛡️ Liquid Network patched after $320M Bitcoin exploit Blockstream said bridge nodes were patched after an exploit drained roughly $320 million in bitcoin from Liquid Network. The attacker has indicated most of the funds will be returned once the fix is verified. Read full story 🏦 Citi and DBS complete weekend tokenized USD payment on Swift Citi and DBS completed a cross-border U.S. dollar payment over the weekend using tokenized deposits on Swift’s Digital Ledger, demonstrating 24/7 settlement outside traditional banking hours. The Transaction v1 upgrade is designed to support more complex proofs, multisig operations and application workflows. Read full story 🛢️ Bitcoin slips as oil rises on escalating Middle East tensions Bitcoin traded lower as oil prices rose following new U.S. strikes on Iranian crude carriers, reinforcing a risk-off tone across markets and highlighting crypto’s sensitivity to geopolitical shocks.
